## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

Two independent bearers, neither following from the other — each is a
ViewModel that already writes the change and would carry the push call:

- `RaceDetailViewModel` — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racedetail/RaceDetailViewModel.kt,
  `onSetAsReferenceClicked`, `onRenameConfirmed`, `onDeleteConfirmed`
- `ImportPreviewViewModel` — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/importpreview/ImportPreviewViewModel.kt,
  `onSaveClicked`

## Trigger

- "Définir comme référence" tapped on the race detail screen
  (`onSetAsReferenceClicked`) — observed
- The rename dialog's "Enregistrer" on the race detail screen
  (`onRenameConfirmed`) — observed
- The delete confirmation's "Supprimer" on the race detail screen
  (`onDeleteConfirmed`) — observed
- "Enregistrer" tapped on the import preview screen (`onSaveClicked`) — observed

## Today

`RaceDetailViewModel.onSetAsReferenceClicked` calls
`raceRepository.setAsReference(raceId)` and nothing else.
`onRenameConfirmed` calls `raceRepository.rename(raceId, name)` and only
resets the dialog's field afterward. `onDeleteConfirmed` calls
`raceRepository.delete(raceId)` and, on success, only calls
`navigator.back()`. `ImportPreviewViewModel.onSaveClicked` calls
`raceRepository.saveImportedRace(...)` and, on success, only navigates
to the new race's detail screen. None of the four holds a reference to
`ProfileSyncPushService`, and none calls it.

The only call to `ProfileSyncPushService.push` in the project is inside
`ProfileViewModel.pushProfile` (app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt),
itself reached from two places: `onSyncClicked` — the profile screen's
sync/retry button — and a collector on
`linkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()` started in `ProfileViewModel.init`,
which runs only while the profile screen's ViewModel is alive. Renaming,
deleting, importing or setting a race as reference never runs that
method, on any screen.

## Expected

Each of the four call sites pushes after its write succeeds, the same
way `ProfileViewModel.pushProfile` already does: call
`ProfileSyncPushService.push(permissionGranted, at)` and record the
outcome. `ProfileSyncPushService` (bound as a `@Singleton` in
`app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/di/SyncModule.kt`) and
`Clock` (bound in `app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/di/TimingModule.kt`)
are both already provided app-wide through Hilt's `SingletonComponent`,
so both are reachable from any `@HiltViewModel` — `RaceDetailViewModel`
and `ImportPreviewViewModel` currently declare neither as a constructor
dependency and need it added to call `push`.
`RaceRecordingRepository`, `HrHistoryReader`, `HrPermissionSystem` and
`ConnectivityPermissionManager` are not needed for this: `pushProfile`
already passes `permissionGranted = true` unconditionally, regardless
of the actual connectivity permission state.
